result.title: MonoMIP: Multi-Height Inverse Perspective Mapping for Monocular 3D Object Detection
result.comment: Accepted to ACCV 2026. 18 pages main paper and 14 pages supplementary material
result.summary: Monocular 3D object detection methods increasingly rely on depth-guided transformers, but they operate entirely in the perspective image plane where spatial relationships are distorted by foreshortening. We propose MonoMIP, a dual-decoder framework that adds complementary 3D geometric reasoning through Bird's-Eye View (BEV) features constructed via Multi-Height Inverse Perspective Mapping. We perform IPM at K elevation planes spanning ground to rooftop, producing an ordered stack of height-conditioned metric BEV features that reduces above-ground misprojection and exposes depth-dependent appearance variation across planes. A BEV decoder with multi-scale deformable attention aggregates this multi-height evidence per query, while a depth-guided 3D decoder provides complementary perspective-space predictions. Without extra training data, MonoMIP attains 25.84% Moderate AP3D|R40 on KITTI val and 21.66% on the official test set for Car, outperforming recent published monocular methods on both the KITTI and Waymo benchmarks.

AI.brief_summary: 面向单目 3D 目标检测，提出双解码器框架 MonoMIP：在地面到车顶的 K 个高度平面上做逆透视变换，得到按高度排序的度量 BEV 特征栈，再用多尺度可变形注意力按 query 聚合多高度证据，与深度引导的透视图解码器互补，在 KITTI 与 Waymo 上优于近期单目方法。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「多高度平面特征栈 + 按 query 聚合多高度证据」接近视觉侧的多假设表示与证据筛选，可能为 LVR 中多种 latent 假设及视觉证据筛选提供线索；但任务属驾驶场景 3D 检测，迁移到 VLM 推理尚需核查。
